Please continue this in #4203, which already covers the same link fix and question about opening a PR. Describe proposed changes in an issue first; Rich limits PRs to collaborators. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) for contribution requirements.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
